entry.title: Deng [2026] FedCFamC2F 1192
entry.content:
The mother, a Chinese citizen, applied for parenting orders to allow her child to be included as a dependant on her skilled work visa. The father was unknown and could not be located, so the Court dispensed with service and made orders for the child to live with the mother and for her to have sole parental responsibility, finding it was in the child's best interests.

Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia (Division 2), 5 Aug 2026, [2026] FedCFamC2F 1192
